critique: The complete equivalence and separator theorems settle the singleton-permitting blocked subclass, not Question 20 for general edge-coloured DAGs, because cross-target colour classes remain excluded. The proved sharpness concerns the worst-case cardinality of the specifically defined binary-star library; optimal support and rational height among all universal separator schemes remain open in certificate-pareto-optimality. The statistical rung is pointwise, fixed-p, and based on exhaustive global BIC away from algebraic intersections, so it proves neither uniform inference nor consistency of a feasible search procedure. The framing retains these qualifiers and does not falsely claim general edge-colour equivalence, Pareto-optimal certificates, or uniform statistical recovery.
